name: Decimal keypad → binary · 0–9999
detail: Ten digit buttons feed four BCD bit-plane shift registers. Each separate press shifts the existing 4-digit number left and inserts the new digit on the right; older digits fall off after 4 presses. The 4 seven-segment displays show the stored decimal digits, including leading zeros. Full Adders convert their place values into binary.
check: Press 1, then 2: the display reads 0012. Cyan binary outputs are labeled with weights 1 through 8192; add the lit weights to get the displayed number. Let a key release before pressing the next. Press 0 4 times to clear all digits.
